visual.title: A small sample widens the reference
visual.caption: The t curve depends on the degrees of freedom. At 5 degrees of freedom its tails are heavy, so a statistic of 2.0 is not yet past the two-sided 5 percent critical value.

predict.question: At 5 degrees of freedom the two-sided critical value is about 2.571. What happens at t = 2.0?
predict.explain: The observed 2.0 is inside the critical value 2.571, so the two-sided p-value is above 0.05 and the null is not rejected.
